This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mid-Level Proposal Analyst – Energy Industries based in Brazil.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Proposal Analyst to support technical and commercial proposal development within the energy and industrial automation sector. In this role, you will prepare competitive proposals for power generation automation solutions, serving customers across Brazil and Latin America. You will work with technologies such as static excitation systems, automatic voltage regulators, synchronization, and hydropower plant automation. Collaborating with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and international teams, you will ensure that proposals meet technical requirements while remaining commercially competitive. You will also assess project costs, identify contractual and operational risks, and contribute to strategic bidding decisions. This is an opportunity to work on complex engineering projects within a global technology environment while supporting more reliable and efficient energy generation.

lists.content:
As a Proposal Analyst, you will coordinate the preparation of technical, commercial, and financial offers, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness, and compliance with internal standards. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams and external suppliers to define project scope, assess risks, optimize costs, and deliver high-quality proposals for customers across the region.

  • Prepare competitive technical and commercial proposals, estimates, and quotations, selecting appropriate products and solutions based on each opportunity's technical and commercial requirements.

  • Coordinate the preparation of proposal documentation, including technical specifications, commercial conditions, financial information, and pricing spreadsheets.

  • Review technical documentation, customer requirements, and specifications for complex projects and engineered products in collaboration with Engineering teams.

  • Identify inconsistencies, technical deviations, project risks, and assumptions, proposing clarifications and mitigation measures to ensure accurate proposal scope definition.

  • Estimate and consolidate costs associated with field services, engineering, commissioning, and spare parts.

  • Prepare budgetary quotations to help Sales teams and customers evaluate potential investments.

  • Identify risks within proposals and contracts and participate in risk review processes alongside Legal, Risk Management, and Trade Compliance teams when required.

  • Ensure adherence to internal policies, governance requirements, controls, and proposal management procedures, coordinating the necessary approvals.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, and suppliers to evaluate technical offers and coordinate subcontractor quotations.

  • Monitor proposal progress, document assumptions and key decisions, and maintain accurate records throughout the bidding process.

  • Analyze the reasons behind won and lost proposals to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate with Latin American teams on regional projects and cross-border commercial opportunities.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has an engineering or technology background, combined with experience in technical and commercial proposals for power generation automation projects. You should have strong analytical and cost estimation skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate complex information across different departments and international stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology or Engineering, preferably in Control and Automation, Electrical Engineering, or Electronics.

  • Professional experience with automation projects for power generation.

  • Experience preparing technical and commercial proposals, including reviewing engineering documentation and customer project specifications.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

  • At least intermediate English proficiency for communication and collaboration with global teams.

  • Knowledge of cost estimation, pricing methodologies, and financial structuring of technical and commercial proposals.

  • Understanding of the main tax concepts applicable to the sale of products, systems, and services, including their impact on cost calculations, pricing, and commercial offer structures across different supply arrangements.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple proposal activities and deadlines.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with technical, commercial, and international teams.

    • Additional qualifications that would be considered an advantage:

  • Advanced Spanish proficiency for collaboration with Latin American teams.

  • Previous experience in hydropower generation projects.

  • Familiarity with excitation systems, automatic voltage regulators, SCADA or DCS systems, power electronics, motors, or generators.

  • Knowledge of simulation technologies and digital twin solutions.

    • Benefits:

  • Opportunity to work with high-technology solutions serving the energy and power generation industries.

  • Exposure to international projects and collaboration with teams across Latin America and global manufacturing facilities.

  • Hybrid working arrangement, with two days per week working on-site.

  • Collaborative environment supported by an experienced team.

  • Opportunities to contribute creative ideas and innovative approaches to cost optimization and successful project bidding.

  • Continuous professional development within a global technology organization.

  • Access to a broad range of employee benefits, rewards, and career development opportunities.

  • Inclusive and supportive workplace that values diversity, integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Analyst (Analista QA Sênior) based in Brazil.

As a Senior QA Analyst, you will play a fundamental role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software products across web, backend, mobile, and API environments. You will take ownership of testing strategies and plans, combining manual and automated testing to identify risks and prevent defects throughout the software development lifecycle. Working closely with engineering teams, you will validate applications, execute end-to-end integration tests, and drive continuous quality improvements. You will also contribute to strengthening QA practices through technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and mentoring other team members. Using modern testing tools and Agile methodologies, you will help optimize engineering workflows and ensure high-quality product delivery. This is an opportunity to join a collaborative technology environment that values technical expertise, initiative, and continuous improvement.

lists.content:
• Define, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies and plans for product functionalities, covering both manual and automated testing whenever appropriate.
  • Perform functional and non-functional testing across web applications, backend systems, mobile applications, and APIs.
  • Identify, document, track, and report software defects, ensuring clear communication of issues, corrective actions, and resolution status.
  • Evaluate application usability and provide recommendations to improve functionality and the overall user experience.
  • Design and execute integration and end-to-end (E2E) tests using Cypress or similar automation frameworks.
  • Validate API functionality and integrations using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, Swagger, and GraphQL testing solutions.
  • Collaborate with developers, product teams, and stakeholders to identify potential quality risks and ensure requirements are properly validated.
  • Maintain comprehensive testing documentation, test cases, and quality standards within internal knowledge bases.
  • Use test management tools to organize test plans, monitor execution, and track quality results.
  • Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, methodologies, and engineering practices, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support the onboarding and technical development of team members by sharing knowledge, testing methodologies, and best practices.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent and reliable software delivery.
  • Promote quality throughout the software development lifecycle, helping prevent defects and ensuring products meet established quality standards.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of professional experience testing web applications, backend systems, mobile applications, and APIs.
  • Experience performing both functional and non-functional software testing.
  • Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, test planning, test case design, execution, and defect management.
  • Practical experience working with Agile methodologies and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience creating and executing test plans using test management tools such as Jira and Zephyr.
  • Hands-on knowledge of API testing tools, including Postman, SoapUI, and Swagger.
  • Experience testing GraphQL APIs and validating integrations between different systems.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control practices.
  • Knowledge of databases, particularly MongoDB, with the ability to validate data and investigate potential inconsistencies.
  • Understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) processes and experience with tools such as Jenkins.
  • Experience with end-to-end integration testing, particularly using Cypress or similar frameworks.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify risks and quality improvement opportunities.
  • Proactive and collaborative mindset, with the ability to contribute to team objectives and continuously improve processes.
  • Flexibility and adaptability when working in dynamic environments with evolving priorities and technical requirements.
  • Strong communication and knowledge-sharing skills, with the ability to document best practices and support colleagues.
  • A completed or ongoing university degree in Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field is desirable.

    • Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) testing methodologies and tools such as Cucumber.
  • Familiarity with logging, observability, and monitoring tools such as Kiali, Graylog, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6.
  • Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence to accelerate software quality assurance and testing workflows.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered development and testing tools such as Claude Code and Playwright.
  • Ability to integrate AI-assisted testing approaches throughout the software development lifecycle to improve test coverage, efficiency, and delivery speed.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement, open to candidates anywhere in Brazil.
  • Full-time professional engagement under an independent contractor (PJ) arrangement.
  • Opportunity to work with modern software testing technologies and automation frameworks.
  • Exposure to AI-powered QA tools and innovative testing methodologies.
  • Opportunity to contribute to quality engineering strategies and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborative environment with opportunities for technical knowledge sharing and professional development.
  • Possibility to mentor colleagues and help strengthen engineering quality practices.
  • Dynamic technology environment focused on innovation, software quality, and continuous learning.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analyst, Growth Generalist based in Brazil.

We are looking for a proactive and analytical Growth Generalist to strengthen an international Marketing & Growth team and drive customer acquisition across the Americas and Europe.
In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of paid media campaigns while contributing to broader growth initiatives across outbound, reporting, automation, and AI-powered workflows.
You will manage campaigns across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn, optimizing budgets, audiences, creatives, and performance to attract high-quality B2B leads.
Beyond paid advertising, you will help build scalable acquisition processes, develop reporting dashboards, and improve lead generation through data and automation.
You will work closely with growth, sales, and revenue operations teams in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.
This position offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to influence acquisition strategy, experiment with new tools, and take ownership beyond traditional marketing responsibilities.
It is an excellent opportunity for an adaptable professional who enjoys combining hands-on execution, analytical thinking, and continuous learning.

lists.content:
• Paid Media Strategy and Management: Own paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads, covering strategy, campaign setup, execution, daily optimization, and performance reporting.
  • Audience Targeting: Define and refine target audiences based on the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), ensuring advertising budgets are focused on reaching relevant businesses and decision-makers.
  • Budget Management: Collaborate with growth leadership to allocate and optimize advertising budgets across different channels and geographical markets.
  • Campaign Experimentation: Continuously test audiences, advertising creatives, landing pages, and offers to identify improvement opportunities and translate findings into actionable decisions.
  • Creative Production: Develop static and video advertising assets using AI-powered tools and other creative resources, enabling fast experimentation without relying exclusively on external designers.
  • Outbound Acquisition Support: Research and identify target companies and relevant contacts, enrich prospect data using Clay and similar tools, build lead lists, and support outbound prospecting sequences.
  • Performance Reporting: Build, maintain, and improve dashboards that track acquisition channel performance, lead generation, and campaign effectiveness, translating data into clear business recommendations.
  • Automation and AI Integration: Contribute to the development and optimization of automated workflows and AI agents supporting lead sourcing, qualification, follow-ups, and reporting.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales and revenue operations teams to improve lead quality, streamline handoffs, and ensure accurate attribution of marketing-generated opportunities.
  • Marketing Alignment: Coordinate with communications and brand teams to maintain consistency between brand messaging, campaign creatives, and paid advertising activities.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to expand beyond paid media ownership and improve the overall customer acquisition engine through experimentation, initiative, and practical problem-solving.

    • Requirements:

  • Professional Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on paid media experience using at least two of the following platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads. B2B advertising experience is a strong advantage.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to work confidently with data, monitor campaign performance, interpret results, and communicate findings through measurable outcomes.
  • AI Proficiency: Regular practical use of AI-powered tools in daily work, combined with curiosity and enthusiasm for exploring new applications that improve productivity and marketing performance.
  • Adaptability: Ability to learn quickly, adjust to changing priorities, and make informed decisions based on new information.
  • Versatility: Comfortable taking on responsibilities outside your primary area of expertise and contributing to different parts of the acquisition and growth process.
  • English Proficiency: Fluent English is essential, as the role involves collaborating with international teams and working across markets in the Americas and Europe.
  • Ownership and Initiative: Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently, taking responsibility for decisions, execution, and results.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with marketing, sales, and revenue operations stakeholders.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience with CRM and prospecting platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Clay.
  • Basic graphic design or video production skills, particularly for creating advertising assets.
  • Previous experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, or startup environments where team members take on diverse responsibilities.
  • Familiarity with the floriculture industry or related B2B supply chain markets.
  • Experience working with international teams and managing campaigns across multiple geographical markets.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive and negotiable salary based on experience, skills, and qualifications.
  • Remote-First Work Environment: Fully remote working arrangements with the flexibility to work from different locations.
  • International Exposure: Collaborate with a diverse, globally distributed team operating across the Americas and Europe.
  • Ownership and Autonomy: Take responsibility for meaningful projects, make independent decisions, and directly contribute to business growth.
  • Professional Development: Opportunities to continuously develop your skills and expand your expertise in growth marketing, paid acquisition, and automation.
  • Learning Support: Financial assistance for technical certifications and other professional learning opportunities.
  • Flexible Work Culture: Work in an independent and versatile environment that encourages initiative, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Career Growth: Opportunity to broaden your responsibilities and develop into a more strategic growth role within a fast-growing international organization.

You will lead data modeling initiatives, translating complex business requirements into efficient, well-structured, and maintainable data architectures. Using advanced SQL and modern cloud technologies, you will ensure data quality, performance, and governance across critical business processes. You will also collaborate closely with Product Managers and functional analysts to identify opportunities and deliver proactive technical solutions. lists.content:

  • Ensure data reliability by implementing automated data tests, quality monitoring processes, and comprehensive technical documentation.

  • Maintain the accuracy and consistency of critical business indicators, supporting trustworthy reporting and informed decision-making.

  • Optimize SQL queries and data pipelines to improve performance, scalability, processing efficiency, and cost-effectiveness across large data volumes.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, functional analysts, and business stakeholders to understand complex requirements and translate business needs into effective data architecture solutions.

  • Lead technical requirement gathering and proactively identify opportunities to improve data processes, architecture, and development workflows.

  • Act as a technical reference for the team, promoting software engineering best practices through code reviews, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

  • Encourage the adoption of self-service analytics practices, empowering business stakeholders to access and use reliable data independently.

  • Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to investigate root causes, challenge assumptions, and propose solutions that address underlying business challenges.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of data engineering standards, governance practices, and development processes.

    • Requirements:

  • Proven experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related data-focused technical role, with the ability to operate as a technical reference for the team.

  • Strong autonomy in gathering and analyzing requirements, translating business needs into technical specifications, and managing deliverables from conception through implementation.

  • Advanced SQL skills, including experience writing complex, high-performance queries and developing data transformations in Google BigQuery.

  • Solid experience with dimensional data modeling, designing optimized analytical tables, and implementing modern data architectures, particularly Data Lakehouse environments.

  • Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especially cloud storage and data processing services.

  • Practical experience with Apache Airflow or similar data orchestration tools for managing pipeline dependencies, scheduling, execution, and failure monitoring.

  • Strong software engineering practices applied to data development, including Git version control, code reviews, pull requests, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience designing scalable, maintainable, and well-documented data solutions aligned with business requirements.

  • Excellent analytical and critical-thinking abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying root causes and improving technical processes.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, Product Managers, functional analysts, and business stakeholders.

  • Ability to mentor colleagues, share technical knowledge, and promote engineering standards and data-driven practices.

    • Nice to have:

  • Practical experience using Generative AI tools such as Gemini, Copilot, or Cursor to accelerate development workflows.

  • Experience implementing AI agents for task automation, data quality monitoring, or integration into data pipelines.

  • Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, orchestration, and exploratory data analysis.

  • Experience extracting and integrating data through third-party APIs, such as Google, Meta, or Salesforce, including authentication, pagination, and incremental data loading.

  • Knowledge of FinOps practices, including monitoring cloud processing costs and latency and optimizing queries to improve resource efficiency.

  • Advanced knowledge of data science, statistical modeling, and machine learning techniques.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytics Engineering Manager, Data Platform & Governance based in Brazil.

In this hands-on leadership role, you will establish and lead the data governance function for a growing, multi-brand home services marketplace. You will take ownership of the trustworthiness, quality, security, and accessibility of data across the entire platform, from source systems and pipelines to business intelligence and AI-powered applications. Working with a modern data stack built around Redshift, dbt, Airflow, Segment, and Lightdash, you will define the governance roadmap and turn business needs into clear technical priorities. You will strengthen data quality monitoring, lineage, metric consistency, and event tracking standards while supporting the organization's transition to a unified BI platform. Starting as an individual contributor, you will build scalable processes and automation before growing the team. This is an opportunity for a technically strong, AI-enabled manager who enjoys building systems, influencing stakeholders, and creating lasting improvements.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Brazil.

We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer to design, build, and test intelligent conversational experiences and AI agents embedded in learner-facing products. You will transform product and instructional requirements into reliable AI behavior across advisory tools, practice simulations, and diagnostic coaching experiences. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Content Studios, and subject-matter experts, you will help ensure AI systems deliver accurate, consistent, and safe interactions. Your work will cover the full development lifecycle, from prompt design and prototyping to evaluation, production deployment, and ongoing monitoring. You will also contribute to the technical safeguards needed to support privacy, human oversight, and accreditation requirements. This is a fully remote, long-term opportunity within an Agile-oriented environment focused on developing innovative learning technologies for regulated professional industries.

lists.content:
As an Applied AI Engineer, you will translate complex learning scenarios and product requirements into robust AI workflows. You will take ownership of conversational behavior, integration architecture, testing, and production readiness while collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure that AI-powered experiences remain reliable and aligned with their intended purpose.

  • Translate scenario specifications, decision models, and assessment rubrics into prompts, application logic, and testable AI behaviors.

  • Identify missing requirements, technical constraints, and potential risks, escalating them to Product, Engineering, and subject-matter experts.

  • Define how AI models interact with application services and approved data sources, including APIs, tools, data structures, validation rules, error handling, and permitted actions.

  • Design system prompts, structured outputs, and validation mechanisms to detect and prevent invalid responses from reaching learners.

  • Build conversational runtimes with controlled personas, session state, and clearly defined state transitions.

  • Separate simulation behavior, assessment logic, and feedback mechanisms to ensure that feedback does not influence assessment outcomes.

  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and grounding from approved knowledge sources, including source references where required.

  • Maintain version control and documentation for code, prompts, schemas, and evaluation assets.

  • Run structured experiments with Product teams, defining clear objectives and measurable success criteria.

  • Move validated prototypes into production in collaboration with Engineering and verify that deployed behavior remains consistent.

  • Contribute to technical controls supporting accreditation and compliance requirements, including issue flagging, review workflows, disclosures, and logging.

  • Monitor and evaluate AI performance, identifying opportunities to improve quality, reliability, security, and efficiency.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has hands-on experience developing LLM-powered applications and multi-step conversational workflows. You combine strong technical expertise in prompt engineering, agentic systems, retrieval, and evaluation with sound judgment around AI safety, privacy, and human oversight. You are comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can communicate complex trade-offs clearly.

  • Expert-level prompt and context engineering, including system prompts, few-shot examples, prompt chaining, routing, and breaking complex tasks into manageable steps.

  • Strong experience with structured outputs, JSON Schema, function calling, validation layers, and retry and fallback mechanisms.

  • Practical knowledge of RAG architecture, including chunking, metadata filtering, hybrid search, reranking, and citation grounding.

  • Experience managing token budgets, prompt caching, context compaction, and long-session memory.

  • Expertise in agentic systems, including tool use, planner/executor patterns, multi-agent orchestration, state machines, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

  • Ability to define tool schemas, permission scopes, and action limits for AI agents.

  • Experience with AI evaluation methods such as golden datasets, rubric-based scoring, LLM-as-judge calibrated against human reviewers, and regression testing.

  • Familiarity with LLM observability, tracing, and performance monitoring.

  • Strong understanding of LLM security risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, jailbreaks, unsafe tool actions, and guardrails.

  • Ability to compare prompting, retrieval, and model options based on quality, latency, and cost.

  • Proficiency in Python or TypeScript, including API integrations and automated testing.

  • Experience with Git-based version control (such as Bitbucket), reproducible tests, and continuous integration.

  • Comfortable using AI coding agents as part of your standard development workflow.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to non-technical colleagues.

  • Sound judgment regarding privacy, human oversight, and the limitations of AI-generated assessments or advice.

  • Demonstrated experience building LLM applications with multi-step conversational workflows.

  • Experience collaborating with subject-matter experts to translate domain knowledge into effective AI behavior.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background in learning technology products, professional assessment, conversational simulations, or regulated industry content.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement.

  • Long-term professional opportunity.

  • Opportunity to build and improve AI-powered learning experiences used in regulated professional industries.

  • Collaborative, Agile-oriented environment with cross-functional teams.

  • Exposure to advanced LLM applications, conversational agents, and applied AI development challenges.

• Oversee the activities of team members, vendors, and matrix stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely payments to clinical investigative sites across the Americas.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Assurance Climate Risk Consultant based in Brazil.

This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the development of climate risk assessment and disclosure solutions within an innovative, technology-driven sustainability environment. You will work primarily as an internal advisor, collaborating with Professional Services and Product teams to build robust climate risk indicators, scenario analysis methodologies, and disclosure-ready frameworks. A key priority will be supporting enterprise clients' CSRD readiness through gap analyses, preliminary disclosures, and documentation that can withstand external limited-assurance reviews. You will combine expertise in climate science, financial risk assessment, and sustainability assurance to translate complex regulatory and technical requirements into practical methodologies. The position is particularly suited to an experienced assurance professional who can connect climate risk analysis with financial implications, regulatory compliance, and software-enabled solutions.

lists.content:
• Develop and refine climate risk indicators and comprehensive frameworks covering both physical and transition risks.

  • Design indicators using the IPCC AR6 hazard, exposure, and vulnerability framework, including thresholds, normalization methods, scoring and classification logic, and aggregation from grid cells to assets, basins, and portfolios.

  • Support the development of climate scenario analysis solutions aligned with IFRS S2 and ESRS methodologies, including selecting, processing, and validating climate projection datasets across emissions scenarios, time horizons, and baseline periods.

  • Prepare detailed indicator specifications, data dictionaries, and methodology documentation that Product and Engineering teams can implement and that provide sufficient auditability for client disclosures.

  • Assess the financial implications of climate scenarios, including cost modeling and financial impact assessments across sectors such as manufacturing, technology, and textiles.

  • Contribute to the development of climate resilience and adaptation opportunity libraries linked to identified potential risks.

  • Validate climate indicators against observed data and published benchmarks, conduct sensitivity analyses, and establish methods for communicating uncertainty and confidence to platform users.

  • Support climate-related disclosure preparation in accordance with CSRD/ESRS and IFRS S2, including identifying and mapping relevant data points, metrics, and reporting requirements.

  • Lead and support CSRD limited-assurance readiness activities by establishing evidence trails, controls, and documentation capable of withstanding external assurance reviews.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving CSRD/ESRS and IFRS regulatory guidance, identifying changes that may affect ongoing projects and internal methodologies.

  • Collaborate with the Professional Services team to translate technical climate and disclosure requirements into practical internal frameworks, methodologies, and deliverables.

  • Contribute to CSRD requirements gap analyses and define the work needed for preliminary disclosures, dry runs, and first-time reporting exercises.

  • Ensure consistency and alignment between climate risk methodologies and existing water risk indicators.

  • Deliver internal training and knowledge-sharing sessions to strengthen the broader team's understanding of climate risk and disclosure requirements.

    • Requirements:

  • Mandatory assurance experience: Hands-on experience in sustainability or climate assurance at a Big Four firm, ideally within a Climate Change and Sustainability Services practice, including CSRD/ESRS or climate-related assurance engagements. Candidates must understand the evidence, controls, and documentation required to successfully support a limited-assurance review. This is a non-negotiable requirement.

  • Bachelor's degree in Climate Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability, or a related discipline. A Master's degree or PhD in Climate Science, Atmospheric Science, Hydrology, Geosciences, or a related field is also expected.

  • At least 7 years of senior-level experience in climate risk and resilience assessment, corporate sustainability, climate disclosure consulting, or sustainability assurance.

  • Demonstrated experience leading or owning climate risk, sustainability reporting, or CSRD-related engagements from beginning to end.

  • Strong working knowledge of climate-related financial disclosure frameworks, particularly IFRS S2, together with familiarity with CSRD and ESRS requirements.

  • Experience working with physical and transition climate risk scenarios and datasets, including NGFS scenarios, IEA pathways, carbon price trajectories, and sector decarbonization pathways such as SBTi and TPI.

  • Understanding of how climate scenarios translate into financial impacts, including the ability to assess potential costs and business exposure.

  • Experience integrating climate risk considerations into enterprise risk management systems and corporate disclosure frameworks.

  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with the ability to work confidently with complex information and evolving regulatory requirements.

  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to translate technical climate concepts into clear, practical internal guidance.

    • Preferred qualifications:

  • Interest in software, technology, or digital transformation, particularly in the context of technology-enabled advisory platforms.

  • Experience with double materiality assessments under CSRD/ESRS and familiarity with financial materiality approaches under TCFD and IFRS frameworks.

  • Exposure to climate disclosure requirements across multiple countries or regulatory jurisdictions.

  • Experience supporting sustainability or climate disclosures through external limited-assurance engagements.

  • Experience translating climate risk methodologies and deliverables into structured data models or indicators suitable for integration into software platforms.

    • Core skills and competencies:

  • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.

  • Self-motivation, initiative, and the ability to work effectively with ambiguous or evolving requirements.

  • Collaborative approach and ability to work with cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Independence and accountability, with the ability to deliver results with limited day-to-day supervision.

  • Proactive problem-solving skills, including identifying gaps, risks, and unresolved questions before they become obstacles.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working environment.

  • Unlimited paid time off.

  • Opportunity to contribute to a meaningful environmental mission focused on water security and sustainability.

  • Opportunity to work alongside a talented, mission-driven, and collaborative team.

  • Professional growth opportunity within an expanding Climate Tech sector.

  • Inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, collaboration, respect, ownership, continuous improvement, and shared success.

We are seeking a results-driven, bilingual Sales Development Representative to support patient acquisition for a rapidly growing healthcare organization specializing in advanced vein treatments. In this role, you will serve as the first point of contact for prospective patients, combining consultative sales skills with a compassionate, patient-first approach. You will manage high-volume inbound and outbound communications, explain treatment options, address insurance-related questions, overcome objections, and convert qualified leads into scheduled consultations. Working closely with clinical and operational teams, you will help ensure a seamless patient journey from the initial inquiry through appointment booking. This position is ideal for someone with experience in medical call centers, patient scheduling, healthcare administration, or high-volume sales environments. You will join a performance-driven, international team where productivity, patient satisfaction, accountability, and continuous improvement are essential.

lists.content:
• Patient Lead Management: Serve as the first point of contact for prospective patients, responding to inquiries and building trust through professional, empathetic, and informative interactions.
  • Inbound and Outbound Communications: Proactively engage with patients through phone calls, emails, and text messages to follow up on leads, answer questions, and encourage appointment scheduling.
  • Appointment Generation: Guide prospective patients through the booking process, securing consultations and vein evaluations with ultrasound examinations across a network of more than 60 clinics.
  • Consultative Sales: Understand patient concerns, explain available treatment options, address objections, and confidently guide individuals from initial interest to a scheduled appointment.
  • Insurance Verification and Payment Guidance: Explain insurance coverage and available payment options, verify patient insurance information, initiate authorization requests, and help minimize financial and administrative barriers to booking.
  • CRM and EMR Management: Maintain accurate and complete patient records, document all interactions, and manage relevant information across Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Electronic Medical Records (EMR), and phone systems.
  • Patient Concern Resolution: Address questions and concerns professionally, adapt communication strategies to individual needs, and provide a positive patient experience throughout the intake process.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth patient handoffs and continuity between the intake process and clinical care.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor individual performance metrics, incorporate coaching and feedback, and continuously refine sales and communication techniques to improve conversion rates and patient satisfaction.
  • Productivity and Quality Standards: Maintain high activity levels while meeting established performance, response-time, follow-up, documentation, and quality assurance expectations.

    • Performance Expectations:

  • Handle up to 100 inbound and outbound calls per day.
  • Consistently schedule approximately 10–15 evaluations with ultrasound examinations daily.
  • Maintain a conversion rate of at least 55% on qualified calls.
  • Ensure 100% accurate documentation of patient interactions in CRM/EMR systems.
  • Maintain efficient response times and consistent follow-up practices.
  • Contribute to positive patient satisfaction scores, including Net Promoter Score (NPS) and direct patient feedback.

    • Requirements:

  • Must be based in Latin America and available to work as an independent contractor. This opportunity is not open to U.S.-based applicants.
  • Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate confidently and naturally with patients during live phone conversations.
  • Previous experience in sales development, medical call centers, patient intake, healthcare administration, front desk scheduling, or insurance-related sales.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare workflows, patient scheduling, and medical administrative processes.
  • Experience with insurance verification, coverage explanations, authorization requests, or patient documentation is highly desirable.
  • Proven ability to convert inbound and outbound calls into booked appointments, with strong persuasion, objection-handling, and closing skills.
  • Comfortable managing high-volume call environments, handling rejection, and working toward measurable productivity and conversion targets.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport, demonstrate empathy, and guide conversations toward clear outcomes.
  • Ability to navigate multiple systems simultaneously, including CRM platforms, EMR software, and phone applications, while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational skills, resilience, and the ability to perform effectively under pressure.
  • A proactive, competitive, and results-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of accountability and ownership.
  • Coachability and willingness to incorporate feedback, participate in performance reviews, and continuously improve.
  • Availability to work full-time according to U.S. time zones, including evening shifts and one weekend day (Saturday or Sunday).
  • Must have a personal computer, noise-cancelling headset, webcam, reliable high-speed internet connection, and a quiet, private workspace.

    • Additional Experience That Is Highly Valued:

  • Previous experience with cold calling, sales development, appointment setting, or lead conversion.
  • Background in medical practices, urgent care centers, dental clinics, or other healthcare environments.
  • Experience in high-volume customer service roles, including hospitality or military-related environments.
  • Familiarity with medical insurance processes, patient intake procedures, and electronic health record systems.
  • Experience working with performance dashboards, conversion metrics, and quality assurance scorecards.

    • Benefits:

  • Monthly Compensation: USD 1,500 in fixed base compensation.
  • Payment Frequency: Compensation paid bi-weekly.
  • Contract Type: Independent contractor engagement, with no commission included.
  • Work Model: 100% remote, available to eligible candidates across Latin America.
  • Schedule: Full-time position aligned with U.S. time zones, including evenings and one weekend day.
  • International Exposure: Opportunity to work with a growing U.S.-based healthcare organization and collaborate with distributed teams.
  • Professional Development: Opportunity to strengthen healthcare sales, patient communication, insurance navigation, and customer relationship management skills.
  • Performance-Driven Environment: Work within a structured environment that values measurable results, productivity, coaching, and continuous improvement.
  • Meaningful Impact: Contribute to improving patient experiences by helping individuals access evaluations and treatment for vein-related conditions.
  • Personal Growth: Join a collaborative team that encourages accountability, resilience, professional development, and a patient-first mindset.

    • Important Contractor Information:

  • The monthly base compensation is fixed at USD 1,500, paid bi-weekly, with no commission.
  • Independent contractors are responsible for managing and paying their own applicable taxes.
  • Contractors must provide their own computer, headset, webcam, internet connection, and suitable private workspace.

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Business Development Director to accelerate business growth across the US and European defence markets. In this strategic role, you will lead new client acquisition and drive revenue through subscription-based research, intelligence, advisory, and consulting solutions. You will take ownership of the complete B2B sales cycle, from identifying new opportunities and developing strategic relationships to negotiating and closing high-value deals. The position requires a strong understanding of the defence sector, an established international network, and the ability to engage effectively with senior decision-makers and C-suite executives. You will use a consultative sales approach to understand complex client challenges and deliver tailored business solutions. Working in a collaborative global environment, you will partner with research, consulting, and delivery teams to identify emerging market opportunities and achieve sustainable commercial growth.

lists.content:
• Lead and manage the complete B2B sales cycle across the US and European markets, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and contract closure.
  • Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities within the defence sector, targeting strategic accounts and high-potential clients.
  • Leverage an established network of clients and prospects to generate qualified leads, strengthen market presence, and accelerate pipeline growth.
  • Develop and execute business development strategies to expand the client portfolio and increase revenue through subscription-based research, intelligence, advisory, and consulting solutions.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders, key decision-makers, and C-suite executives across target accounts.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of defence industry trends, market dynamics, client priorities, and emerging business challenges to deliver a consultative sales approach.
  • Lead client discovery meetings, executive presentations, solution discussions, commercial negotiations, and contract closures.
  • Consistently achieve and exceed revenue, subscription, pipeline, and new-client acquisition targets.
  • Develop, manage, and optimize a healthy sales pipeline across assigned geographies and target industries.
  • Prepare compelling commercial proposals, presentations, and business cases tailored to client requirements and strategic objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with research, consulting, and delivery teams to ensure solutions align with client expectations and deliver measurable business value.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records, including sales activities, opportunity tracking, pipeline management, and revenue forecasts.
  • Monitor defence market developments, competitive activity, and emerging technologies to identify new business opportunities and strengthen sales strategies.
  • Contribute to strategic account planning and territory development to support sustainable revenue growth and long-term client relationships.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Defence Studies, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred.
  • 5–12 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, consultative selling, or subscription-based sales within the defence sector.
  • Demonstrated success in new business acquisition, particularly in hunter-focused and target-driven sales environments.
  • Strong experience selling to clients across the US and European markets, with a solid understanding of regional buying behaviours.
  • Proven ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and relationship development to commercial negotiations and closing.
  • Previous experience selling subscription-based products, market research, business intelligence, advisory, consulting, SaaS, or information services is highly desirable.
  • An established and demonstrable network of clients and prospects across the US and/or European defence markets.
  • Experience engaging with senior stakeholders, strategic decision-makers, and C-suite executives.
  • Consistent track record of achieving or exceeding revenue targets, sales quotas, and new-business acquisition objectives.
  • Excellent consultative selling, solution-selling, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to understand client requirements and translate complex business challenges into valuable solutions.
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms for managing sales pipelines, tracking opportunities, and preparing accurate forecasts.
  • Strong analytical, communication, strategic thinking, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, international, and target-driven environment.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive approach to identifying and developing new business opportunities.
  • Customer-focused attitude, persuasive communication skills, and the ability to build trusted, long-term professional relationships.
  • Passion for defence industry developments, innovation, emerging technologies, disruptive trends, and transformational business growth.

    • Benefits:

  • Friendly and collaborative working environment with an open-door management policy.
  • Strong career progression opportunities and long-term professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work with a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and high performance.
  • Exposure to international colleagues, senior leaders, and cross-functional teams across multiple geographies.
  • Global recognition opportunities through President's Club and Chairman's Club Awards.
  • Continuous learning, coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.
  • Flexible working policy and remote work arrangement.
  • Attractive medical and accident insurance coverage.

This is an exciting opportunity for an entrepreneurial business development professional to drive international growth through strategic B2B partnerships in the recruitment and staffing industry. As an independent freelance partner, you will identify new business opportunities, generate qualified leads, and establish relationships with companies seeking recruitment solutions. You will leverage your existing professional network and commercial expertise to connect with key decision-makers across multiple industries and international markets. Working alongside an established recruitment team, you will help transform promising prospects into long-term commercial partnerships. This fully remote opportunity offers complete flexibility over your working hours, target markets, and business development strategy. With an attractive uncapped commission structure, your earning potential will directly reflect your ability to generate and convert new business opportunities.

lists.content:
• Identify, research, and generate new B2B business opportunities across international markets and multiple industry sectors.
  • Proactively approach companies with current or anticipated recruitment, staffing, and talent acquisition needs.
  • Develop commercial opportunities across sectors including Hospitality, iGaming, Fintech, E-Mobility, Healthcare, Finance and Accounting, Technology, BPO, and other relevant industries.
  • Leverage your existing professional network, industry relationships, and business development experience to introduce potential clients and generate qualified leads.
  • Identify and engage key decision-makers, including HR Directors, Talent Acquisition Leaders, Hiring Managers, and senior executives.
  • Initiate commercial conversations, present recruitment and staffing solutions, and communicate the value of potential partnerships.
  • Qualify prospective clients by understanding their recruitment requirements, hiring volumes, business objectives, and potential collaboration opportunities.
  • Facilitate introductions between qualified prospects and the internal recruitment team to support the development and conversion of commercial opportunities.
  • Build, manage, and continuously develop a strong pipeline of prospective clients across different industries and geographical markets.
  • Establish and nurture long-term business relationships to create recurring commercial opportunities and sustainable revenue streams.
  • Independently define and execute outreach strategies, target markets, prospecting activities, and business development priorities.
  • Monitor market opportunities and industry developments to identify potential clients and expand commercial reach.
  • Collaborate with internal recruitment and delivery teams to ensure a smooth transition from initial client engagement to successful commercial partnerships.

    • Requirements:

  • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in B2B Business Development, Sales, Lead Generation, or a related commercial role.
  • Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, prospecting methodologies, lead qualification, and relationship management.
  • An established professional network or direct access to business decision-makers within one or more relevant industries is a significant advantage.
  • Previous experience identifying new business opportunities and developing commercial relationships across international markets.
  • Confidence in approaching companies, presenting business propositions, and initiating discussions with senior decision-makers.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, networking, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to identify client needs and translate them into potential business opportunities.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, with a proactive and results-oriented approach to generating new business.
  • Ability to work independently, manage your own prospecting activities, and take full ownership of business development objectives.
  • Strong organizational and pipeline management skills, with the ability to prioritize opportunities and maintain consistent outreach.
  • Professional proficiency in English is essential. Additional languages are highly valued.
  • Comfortable working under a fully commission-based freelance arrangement without a fixed salary.
  • Self-motivated and commercially driven, with the ability to build a long-term independent business development partnership.
  • Previous experience in recruitment, staffing, HR services, or talent acquisition is beneficial.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to work across different industries, markets, and international business environments.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote freelance collaboration, open to professionals based anywhere in the world.
  • Complete working flexibility, allowing you to determine your own schedule, geographical markets, target industries, and outreach strategy.
  • Attractive uncapped commission structure, with commission terms agreed in advance for successfully converted client leads.
  • Unlimited earning potential, with no fixed salary or predefined earnings ceiling.
  • Low operational constraints, allowing you to focus on business development without traditional employment obligations.
  • Access to established recruitment infrastructure, expertise, and delivery capabilities to support the conversion of prospective clients into successful partnerships.
  • Dedicated recruitment delivery support, with an internal team managing recruitment operations once commercial partnerships are secured.
  • International business exposure, with opportunities to develop relationships across multiple industries and geographical markets.
  • Potential for recurring income, through successful long-term client relationships, subject to the agreed commission structure.
  • Entrepreneurial independence, with the freedom to build and manage your own business development pipeline.
  • Career growth opportunities, with the potential to progress into broader business development, strategic partnership, or leadership responsibilities as the business expands.
  • Collaborative environment, where your commercial contribution has a direct impact on international business growth.

We are seeking a senior technical leader to shape the architecture and development of an enterprise-grade, agentic AI knowledge platform. In this role, you will combine strategic technical direction with hands-on expertise in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Generative AI, and enterprise search. You will lead the design of intelligent agents capable of navigating complex governance documentation and delivering accurate, secure, and well-cited answers. Your scope will include RAG architecture, content strategy, persona-based experiences, and document lifecycle automation. You will work closely with program leadership, engineering teams, and governance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions. This is an opportunity to lead technical teams, drive innovation, and establish high standards for trustworthy AI in a complex enterprise environment.

lists.content:
• Lead the technical design, configuration, and ongoing development of declarative and custom AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

  • Partner with program leadership, governance document authors, enablement teams, and engineering stakeholders to define platform requirements and agent behavior expectations.

  • Analyze governance documentation, business requirements, and technical specifications to develop accurate, structured, and properly sourced agent configurations.

  • Design and maintain functional and persona-based agent experiences tailored to commercial, functional, engineering, customer, and auditor audiences.

  • Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to improve response accuracy, citation reliability, information security, and grounded answers.

  • Extend native Copilot capabilities where required through Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Microsoft Graph connectors.

  • Establish and maintain content architecture, metadata frameworks, taxonomies, document chunking, and tagging strategies to support effective AI retrieval.

  • Guide search relevance tuning and agent quality assessments, using accuracy measures, adoption indicators, and user feedback to drive improvements.

  • Identify, investigate, and document agent quality issues, providing supporting evidence, logs, and remediation recommendations.

  • Create reusable agent configurations, prompts, runbooks, and technical documentation, ensuring efficiency, portability, traceability, and consistent quality standards.

  • Enable on-demand generation of PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and PDF documents using approved platform content and brand-compliant templates.

  • Implement Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, permissions, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls to ensure agents only expose information users are authorized to access.

  • Maintain configuration artifacts and documentation in line with governance, compliance, and audit requirements.

  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and governance teams to anticipate platform changes, review proposed designs, and validate implementations.

  • Identify technical and delivery risks proactively, escalate critical issues, and recommend mitigation strategies for secure, high-quality deployments.

  • Lead and contribute to Agile delivery practices, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in software, platform, data, or AI solution engineering.

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience managing or directing development teams.

  • Strong track record of designing and delivering software, platform, and data solutions, including taking AI and Large Language Model (LLM) applications into production.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure AI and Machine Learning services.

  • Practical experience developing Generative AI applications and RAG-based solutions.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Copilot Studio for building, configuring, and maintaining AI agents.

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft SharePoint for enterprise content and document management.

  • Experience with database development and solutions involving both structured and unstructured data.

  • Understanding of content architecture, metadata, information retrieval, and data modeling.

  • Proven ability to lead technical delivery and collaborate across distributed teams and multi-vendor stakeholder environments.

  • Strong communication skills and professional English proficiency at C1 level.

  • Proactive, accountable, and ownership-driven approach to problem-solving, with the ability to manage priorities and drive technical outcomes.

  • Nice to have: Experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon Kendra, or broader AWS cloud infrastructure.

  • Nice to have: Experience with Azure AI Search and Azure OpenAI Service for intelligent search and Generative AI applications.

  • Nice to have: Knowledge of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) practices and enterprise information security.

  • Nice to have: Familiarity with GxP compliance standards or experience in healthcare and other regulated industries.

lists.content:
• Partner with the CEO to translate the company’s vision and strategy into a realistic, sequenced execution plan, clarifying priorities, trade-offs, ownership, and deadlines.

  • Design, implement, and manage the organization’s operating system, including annual and quarterly planning, OKRs, weekly leadership meetings, and monthly business reviews.

  • Ensure company-wide and business-unit commitments are clearly assigned, tracked, and delivered, serving as the central point of accountability for execution.

  • Define enterprise and business-unit KPIs, establish trusted scorecards, and build a single source of truth for performance reporting in partnership with Finance and Data teams.

  • Develop and maintain a consistent metric dictionary, ensuring every KPI has a clear definition, source system, refresh cadence, and accountable owner.

  • Identify and measure key drivers of revenue, retention, and costs, using data and business intelligence tools to guide decisions about resources, capital, and priorities.

  • Own the operating tool stack, including dashboards, business intelligence platforms, OKR and planning tools, project tracking systems, and supporting data workflows.

  • Work with business unit leaders to clarify P&L ownership, performance targets, resource allocation, and operational standards.

  • Evaluate business-unit performance and recommend which units should scale, improve, consolidate, or be discontinued, supported by clear financial and operational evidence.

  • Increase leverage across shared services, reduce duplicated work, and establish standardized processes and playbooks that can be reused across business units and acquired companies.

  • Design and evolve the organizational structure, including reporting lines, spans and layers, leadership responsibilities, decision rights, and team models.

  • Establish role clarity and accountability by ensuring every position has a defined owner, responsibilities, and measurable performance expectations.

  • Partner with People & Culture on organizational leveling, succession planning, workforce planning, and the integration of acquired teams.

  • Develop a documented target operating model, including an organizational chart, shared-services boundaries, and a decision-rights framework.

  • Resolve cross-functional friction and operating issues before they escalate to the CEO, acting as a trusted proxy for operational decisions.

  • Lead post-acquisition integration across systems, processes, people, reporting, and operating practices.

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation before introducing additional manual processes or increasing headcount.

  • Assess business-unit performance, leadership accountability, execution risks, and operating metrics during the first 90 days, while establishing an enterprise scorecard and leadership cadence.

    • Requirements

  • At least 8 years of operating leadership experience, including 3 or more years as a COO, General Manager, Founder, VP of Operations, or Integrator with direct accountability for execution against business plans.

  • Demonstrated experience implementing and personally running a formal operating system, such as EOS, OKRs, 4DX, MBO, or an equivalent framework.

  • Proven track record of building KPI and scorecard frameworks and using them to improve business performance.

lists.content:

  • Conduct exploratory data analysis and feature engineering based on business context and the availability of information at the time decisions are made.

  • Validate predictive models using out-of-time performance assessments, stability analysis, calibration, and segment-level results.

  • Apply statistical inference and experimental design techniques when evaluating causal relationships and measuring the impact of business initiatives.

  • Assess model performance by considering the costs of different types of errors and their expected impact on business decisions.

  • Document assumptions, methodologies, results, and model limitations in a clear, structured, and auditable format.

  • Present analytical findings, conclusions, and actionable recommendations to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure analytical solutions address real business needs and support measurable outcomes.

  • Advanced analytical SQL skills for querying, transforming, and analyzing large datasets.

  • Experience working with Apache Spark and cloud-based analytics platforms.

  • Strong knowledge of statistical inference, causal analysis, experimental design, and selection bias.

  • Review clinical trial agreements, budgets, invoices, and supporting documentation to ensure payment accuracy and contractual compliance.

  • Support the setup, execution, and reconciliation of investigator grants and clinical site payments.

  • Reconcile payment transactions and vendor reports, investigate discrepancies, and escalate complex or high-risk issues when necessary.

  • Communicate with investigative sites, vendors, and internal stakeholders regarding payment status, missing documentation, discrepancies, and required next steps.

  • Maintain accurate study and site trackers, payment records, system data, and supporting documentation to ensure audit readiness throughout the study lifecycle.

  • Monitor invoices, payment timelines, outstanding balances, and aging items, ensuring service deadlines are met and potential delays are escalated appropriately.

  • Support purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and coordination with Accounts Payable under appropriate guidance.

  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations, Clinical Site Contracts, Budget Development, Finance, Accounts Payable, and external payment vendors to resolve payment-related questions.

  • Apply country-specific banking, tax, invoicing, documentation, and communication requirements across the Americas.

  • Use relevant financial and clinical systems, potentially including ClinRun, Greenphire, Oracle CTMS, Veeva, SAP, Ariba, Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Teams, Smartsheet, and Power BI.

  • Identify recurring operational challenges, document issues, and contribute practical suggestions for process improvements.

  • Protect confidential information and comply with financial controls, segregation-of-duties requirements, and applicable regulatory and internal procedures.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Life Sciences, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research, pharmaceutical operations, clinical site payments, Accounts Payable, finance, or investigator grant administration.

  • Working knowledge of clinical trial operations, clinical site contracts, invoices, purchase orders, and payment processes.

  • Fluency in English and Spanish, both written and spoken, is required to communicate effectively with international sites and stakeholders.

  • Portuguese proficiency is strongly preferred to support Brazilian clinical research sites.

  • Strong understanding of payment documentation, financial processes, reconciliation, and compliance requirements.

  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook, as well as Teams and SharePoint.

  • Familiarity with clinical trial management systems, financial platforms, or payment management tools is an advantage.

  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to maintain accurate records.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across different teams, cultures, and time zones.

  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize competing deadlines, follow established procedures, and exercise sound judgment when escalating issues.

  • A proactive, analytical, and solutions-oriented approach to resolving discrepancies and improving operational efficiency.

    • Benefits:

  • Remote working opportunity based in Brazil.

  • Opportunity to contribute to international clinical research operations and support clinical trials across the Americas.

  • Exposure to global clinical operations, finance teams, payment platforms, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Opportunity to develop expertise in clinical site payments, investigator grants, financial reconciliation, and clinical trial processes.

  • Collaborative and multicultural working environment.

  • Professional development through exposure to international processes, systems, and operational best practices.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Network DevOps | Júnior based in Brazil.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career technology professional looking to develop expertise in cloud networking, infrastructure, and DevOps practices. In this role, you will support the operation and maintenance of secure, scalable, and resilient network infrastructures across multicloud and hybrid environments. You will work with technologies such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, helping monitor connectivity, troubleshoot incidents, and maintain critical network services. Collaborating with Cloud, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, DevOps, and Support teams, you will contribute to reliable technology operations within the healthcare sector. You will also gain exposure to automation, CI/CD processes, and cloud security while helping improve infrastructure performance and availability. This remote opportunity offers a collaborative environment where continuous learning, technical development, and innovation are encouraged.

lists.content:
• Monitor and provide first- and second-level support for network infrastructure across public cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, as well as hybrid environments.
  • Analyze, diagnose, and troubleshoot connectivity, routing, DNS resolution, and access-related incidents.
  • Support the administration and configuration of cloud connectivity components and enterprise network interconnections, including AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, and Google Cloud Interconnect.
  • Assist with the configuration, maintenance, and updating of VPN tunnels, firewall rules, NAT, DNS, DHCP, and VLANs.
  • Monitor communication links, VPN tunnels, network appliances, and network services, proactively identifying and mitigating potential outages.
  • Manage the creation, tracking, and resolution of service requests and incidents in accordance with IT Service Management (ITSM) practices and established SLAs.
  • Support planned infrastructure changes (GMUD) and the validation of infrastructure improvements, ensuring compliance with operational procedures and security policies.
  • Collaborate with Cloud, Infrastructure, Information Security, DevOps, and Technical Support teams to maintain reliable and secure network environments.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, network topology diagrams, and standardized operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Help identify infrastructure bottlenecks, performance issues, and opportunities for optimization.
  • Contribute to the automation of repetitive operational tasks and the continuous improvement of cloud networking infrastructure.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree completed or currently in progress in Computer Networks, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technology field.
  • Foundational knowledge of networking concepts and essential protocols, including DNS, DHCP, NAT, VLAN, TCP/IP, VPN, and firewall rules.
  • Practical or academic experience with network analysis, connectivity troubleshooting, and routing diagnostics.
  • Basic familiarity with public cloud environments, particularly AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Understanding of technical support processes and IT Service Management (ITSM), including incident, service request, and change management.
  • Analytical mindset, good communication skills, initiative, and willingness to learn new technologies.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and contribute to shared technical objectives.

    • Nice to have:

  • Basic knowledge of infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Familiarity with DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, and container technologies such as Docker.
  • Exposure to dedicated cloud connectivity solutions, including AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, or Google Cloud Interconnect.
  • Entry-level cloud or networking certifications, such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Cisco CCNA, or CompTIA Network+.
  • Basic scripting knowledge using Bash, Python, or PowerShell.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Opportunity to work on managed services projects in multicloud environments within the healthcare sector.
  • Hands-on exposure to leading cloud platforms, networking technologies, and modern infrastructure solutions.
  • Opportunities to develop technical expertise in cloud networking, automation, DevOps, and cybersecurity.
  • Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams and experienced technology professionals.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Exposure to innovative technologies, AI-driven solutions, and evolving industry practices.
  • Opportunity to contribute to secure, scalable, and resilient technology infrastructure.
