This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Commercial HVAC Estimator based in Brazil.

We are looking for a highly experienced Commercial HVAC Estimator to take ownership of estimating for commercial heating, ventilation, and air conditioning projects. In this role, you will review construction drawings and technical specifications, perform detailed material takeoffs, and prepare accurate cost estimates for commercial bids. You will assess materials, labor, equipment, and project requirements while ensuring estimates align with U.S. construction standards. Working directly with business leadership, you will identify scope gaps, clarify technical details, and proactively flag potential cost risks. This remote position requires strong technical expertise, independent judgment, and excellent attention to detail. It offers an opportunity to play a key role in supporting competitive bids and successful commercial construction projects.

lists.content:
As the Commercial HVAC Estimator, you will manage the estimating process from reviewing project documentation through preparing and validating bid submissions. You will ensure estimates are accurate, comprehensive, and clearly documented while maintaining close communication with relevant stakeholders.

  • Perform detailed material takeoffs for commercial HVAC projects using blueprints, construction drawings, and technical specifications.

  • Read, interpret, and analyze mechanical plans, equipment schedules, and project documentation.

  • Calculate quantities for HVAC ductwork, equipment, piping, fittings, insulation, accessories, and other system components.

  • Prepare detailed and accurate cost estimates for commercial project bid submissions.

  • Calculate material quantities, labor requirements, equipment costs, and other relevant project expenses.

  • Review project specifications and applicable U.S. construction standards to ensure estimates accurately reflect the required scope.

  • Identify scope gaps, conflicting information, missing details, and potential cost or execution risks.

  • Document estimating assumptions, exclusions, and items requiring clarification.

  • Coordinate with business leadership and relevant stakeholders regarding project scope, pricing, and bid strategy.

  • Review estimates for accuracy, completeness, and consistency before submission.

  • Work within established estimating systems, software, and workflows.

  • Maintain clear documentation and communication throughout the estimating process to support informed decisions.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on experience specifically in commercial HVAC estimating, with a strong understanding of U.S. construction practices and the ability to independently produce reliable project estimates. You should be comfortable interpreting complex technical documentation, managing competing deadlines, and explaining your estimating decisions clearly.

  • 10+ years of estimating experience, including substantial direct experience in commercial HVAC estimating.

  • Proven track record estimating commercial HVAC projects for contractors or commercial mechanical firms.

  • Strong ability to interpret commercial construction drawings, mechanical plans, equipment schedules, and technical specifications.

  • Demonstrated experience performing HVAC material takeoffs and independently preparing detailed cost estimates.

  • Working knowledge of U.S. commercial construction standards, applicable mechanical codes, and project specifications.

  • Understanding of HVAC materials, installation methods, labor estimating, and commercial bid preparation.

  • Proficiency with estimating and takeoff software such as Bluebeam, PlanSwift, Trimble, or comparable tools.

  • Strong English communication skills, including the ability to explain estimating methodologies and technical decisions clearly.

  • Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and maintain a high level of accuracy in a remote environment.

  • Availability to work full-time during Pacific Time business hours.

  • Willingness to complete a practical technical assessment as part of the interview process.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience working with U.S.-based commercial HVAC contractors or mechanical subcontractors.

  • Experience estimating commercial construction projects such as offices, retail facilities, warehouses, and other commercial buildings.

  • Experience with commercial mechanical or engineering organizations, provided you have direct commercial HVAC estimating experience.

  • Familiarity with HVAC estimating workflows, vendor quotations, labor units, and bid documentation.

  • Ability to provide redacted examples of previous HVAC takeoffs or estimates demonstrating a clear and systematic methodology.

    • What Success Looks Like:

  • Producing accurate, complete, and well-documented commercial HVAC estimates.

  • Proactively identifying scope gaps, missing information, and potential pricing risks.

  • Working independently while maintaining consistent communication with business leadership.

  • Supporting competitive and reliable commercial bid submissions through thorough technical and cost analysis.

    • Benefits:

  • Monthly compensation of $2,000–$2,500 USD, depending on experience.

  • Full-time, fully remote position.

  • Opportunity to work with a U.S.-based commercial HVAC contractor.

  • Direct collaboration with business leadership and ownership of the estimating process.

  • Opportunity to contribute to commercial construction projects while working remotely from Latin America.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Construction Back-Office & Project Coordination Virtual Assistant based in Brazil.

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive Business Support Virtual Assistant to manage the back-office operations of a growing construction business overseeing multiple projects simultaneously. In this full-time remote contractor role, you will ensure that project tasks are clearly assigned, tracked, and followed through to completion. You will coordinate daily communication with subcontractors, internal teams, and clients while keeping project records and schedules up to date. You will also support financial administration, invoice processing, bookkeeping coordination, and document management. Working primarily with Buildertrend, QuickBooks, and Microsoft 365, you will help streamline workflows and maintain operational visibility across projects. This opportunity is ideal for someone who takes ownership, anticipates problems, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where consistent follow-through makes a measurable difference.

lists.content:
You will take responsibility for keeping construction projects and administrative workflows organized, ensuring that tasks are completed on time, communication remains clear, and financial and project records are accurate.

  • Task Management and Follow-Through

  • Convert meeting notes and job-walk summaries into clear, actionable task lists.

  • Assign tasks to the appropriate team members, establish deadlines, and clarify responsibilities with the owner when necessary.

  • Create, organize, and track project tasks in Buildertrend.

  • Follow up on outstanding tasks until they are completed, rather than simply forwarding requests.

  • Review open tasks with the owner and team daily, identifying delays, blockers, and missed deadlines.

  • Escalate issues promptly to keep projects moving forward.

  • Subcontractor, Team, and Client Communication

  • Send task updates and project communications to subcontractors and internal team members.

  • Use Buildertrend messaging and email features to maintain organized, traceable project communication.

  • Contact subcontractors and colleagues by phone when direct follow-up is required.

  • Coordinate schedules, inspections, and service calls.

  • Communicate with clients through email and text, keeping client conversations separate from Buildertrend.

  • Organize communication records by project for easy reference.

  • Bookkeeping Support and Financial Tracking

  • Enter bills and invoices into Buildertrend and QuickBooks.

  • Maintain Excel trackers and cash flow reports as payments, checks, and invoices are received.

  • Prepare client invoices using established Excel templates.

  • Keep accounting records current and ensure transactions are recorded promptly.

  • Coordinate with the bookkeeper regarding financial records, documentation, and questions.

  • Document and Administrative Support

  • Prepare, format, and edit proposals and other business documents using Microsoft Word.

  • Save and organize incoming and outgoing documents for accurate recordkeeping.

  • Maintain organized email correspondence and project files.

  • Handle routine administrative requests from the owner, business partner, and supervisor.

  • Buildertrend Administration and Process Improvement

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information in Buildertrend.

  • Support improvements in the use of Buildertrend for project communication, task tracking, and coordination.

  • Learn and apply new platform features using available training resources.

  • Identify opportunities to make administrative processes more efficient, consistent, and reliable.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced executive assistant, construction administrator, or operations support professional with strong organizational skills and a proven ability to manage multiple priorities. You should be confident communicating with different stakeholders, comfortable working with financial and project management tools, and persistent in following tasks through to completion.

  • Previous experience in executive assistance, construction administration, or operations support is required.

  • Working knowledge of Buildertrend is required; candidates must be comfortable using the platform and learning additional features.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including maintaining trackers and preparing reports.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with a native or near-native level of fluency and communication ability.

  • Strong phone, email, and text communication skills.

  • Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and time management.

  • Demonstrated ability to follow up consistently and take ownership of tasks until they are closed.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships simultaneously.

  • Proactive problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify potential delays and raise concerns early.

  • Dependability, initiative, and the ability to work effectively with a fast-paced, demanding business owner.

  • Comfortable working independently while remaining responsive to instructions and priorities.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience supporting a construction company based in the United States.

  • QuickBooks Desktop or QuickBooks Online data entry experience.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook and Word.

  • Spanish and English bilingual proficiency.

  • Experience using AI-powered meeting transcription tools; training will be provided for the selected contractor.

    • Required Software and Tools:

  • Buildertrend.

  • QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online.

  • Microsoft Excel.

  • Microsoft 365, including Outlook and Word.

  • AI meeting transcription tool, with training provided.

  • Company-provided phone.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation rates.

  • Weekly payments processed according to the independent contractor agreement.

  • Free training and professional upskilling opportunities.

  • Ongoing support and guidance throughout the engagement.

  • Access to a supportive virtual assistant community.

  • Opportunities to explore additional remote contractor roles.

  • Full-time remote engagement with 40 contracted hours per week.

  • Consistent working schedule from Monday to Friday, generally 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a midday break.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Construction Estimating & Project Management Specialist based in Brazil.

This fully remote role offers the opportunity to support a portfolio of more than 30 residential rehabilitation projects in the United States. Working closely with the Director of Construction, you will help keep projects organized, on schedule, and financially controlled. You will oversee essential project documentation, coordinate vendors and trade partners, and support procurement, estimating, and budget tracking. The position combines hands-on construction project management with operational coordination in a fast-paced development environment. Success requires strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to anticipate challenges before they affect project delivery. You will collaborate with remote colleagues and field-based teams while working full-time on Eastern Standard Time (EST).

lists.content:
• Project Documentation and Scheduling: Maintain construction schedules, Gantt charts, and project records. Track daily stand-up notes and weekly production meeting outcomes, and keep project documentation accurate and up to date.

  • Project Administration and Closeout: Manage punch lists, work orders, closeout documentation, and lien release waivers. Support permit and entitlement processes to help projects progress smoothly.

  • Vendor and Trade Partner Coordination: Coordinate scopes of work, contract execution, and communications with trade partners. Collect and maintain W-9 forms, Certificates of Insurance (COIs), and contractor agreements while ensuring tasks are completed according to schedule.

  • Financial and Procurement Support: Assist with material procurement, purchase orders, and vendor sourcing. Process trade partner invoices, reconcile financial records, and maintain visibility into project costs.

  • Estimating and Budget Management: Prepare project estimates, budgets, quantity take-offs, and bid comparisons. Identify potential cost savings and flag recurring financial or operational issues.

  • Design and Specification Coordination: Work with architects and designers to maintain accurate, current specification sheets and ensure relevant project information is accessible.

  • Process Improvement and Reporting: Support operational improvement initiatives, maintain project metrics, and help strengthen processes across the active project portfolio.

  • Leadership Support: Provide direct project management and coordination support to the Director of Construction, helping maintain accountability and consistent progress across multiple projects.

    • Requirements:

  • 4–7 years of experience in construction project management or a closely related field.

  • Strong understanding of construction scheduling methods, including Gantt charts and the Critical Path Method (CPM).

  • Excellent written communication skills, organizational ability, and exceptional attention to detail.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously while maintaining deadlines and holding teams accountable.

  • Practical experience with construction documentation, project records, scheduling, vendor coordination, and financial tracking.

  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and availability to work full-time according to EST business hours.

  • Strongly preferred: Hands-on experience with BuilderTrend or similar construction project management platforms.

  • Familiarity with US construction administration requirements and documentation, including W-9 forms, Certificates of Insurance, and lien waivers.

  • Previous experience supporting remote construction or real estate development teams is an advantage.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to identify risks early and address issues before they escalate.

  • A systems-oriented approach to organizing complex workflows, combined with adaptability and confidence collaborating across time zones and with field-based teams.

    • Benefits:

  • Monthly salary range of $1,500–$2,000.

  • Private health insurance.

  • Paid time off.

  • Fully remote, work-from-home arrangement.

  • Performance-based bonus opportunities.

lists.content:

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Content Manager to develop engaging in-app experiences for a global digital well-being platform. In this role, you will create educational and interactive content designed to help users improve their everyday lives while strengthening engagement and long-term retention. You will transform user needs, feedback, and behavioral insights into meaningful lessons, videos, quizzes, and practical exercises. Working closely with your manager and other team members, you will use AI-powered tools to accelerate content production and explore new formats. You will also manage content implementation and quality assurance to ensure seamless user experiences. This is an exciting opportunity to combine creativity, technology, and purpose while contributing to products that positively impact millions of users worldwide.

lists.content:
Create and manage engaging digital content that supports users throughout their well-being journeys. You will contribute to the development of new content experiences, leverage AI tools to streamline production, and ensure all materials are accurately implemented and tested before release.

  • Develop engaging in-app lessons based on content topics, advertising creatives, user requests, feedback, and identified customer pain points.

  • Collaborate with your manager to create relevant content that improves user engagement and helps reduce subscription cancellations.

  • Write clear, engaging, and accessible English-language content tailored to the platform's audience and objectives.

  • Ensure all content is accurately uploaded and configured within the content management system.

  • Test different user journeys and content flows to identify potential issues and ensure a smooth experience before new releases.

  • Introduce and develop new in-app content formats, including quizzes, practical exercises, and interactive experiences.

  • Coordinate the operational implementation of new content formats, ensuring all materials are properly created and integrated into the content system with support from the team.

  • Produce videos for the application in accordance with the established content calendar and creative guidelines.

  • Leverage existing AI tools and workflows, including Claude, to support video creation and improve content production efficiency.

  • Continuously explore opportunities to improve content quality, variety, and effectiveness through experimentation with AI-powered solutions.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong English writing abilities with practical experience in digital content creation, AI-powered tools, or content management systems. You should be comfortable experimenting with new technologies, working independently, and managing content production tasks with accuracy and attention to detail.

  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher, with the ability to create clear, engaging written content in English from day one.

  • Previous experience writing English-language content. A portfolio is welcome but not mandatory.

  • Regular hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable platforms to create content.

  • Ability to provide 2–3 examples of AI-assisted work, explaining the prompts used, the content produced, and the final results.

  • Alternatively, experience developing personalized AI workflows, including prompt templates, projects, or custom assistants for text or video production.

  • Experience working with a content management system (CMS), administrative panel, or similar platform for uploading and managing digital content.

  • Alternatively, practical experience creating or editing videos using traditional software or AI-powered tools.

  • Strong writing, communication, and organizational skills.

  • Attention to detail and the ability to review content, identify errors, and ensure accuracy before publication.

  • Creativity and curiosity, with an interest in experimenting with new content formats and technologies.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively while taking ownership of assigned responsibilities.

    • Nice-to-have qualifications:

  • Previous experience working in a digital product company.

  • Experience creating different types of content from scratch, including videos, assessments, quizzes, and practical exercises.

  • Previous experience in the wellness or mental health industry.

  • Academic or professional background in psychology or a related discipline.

  • Genuine interest in mental health, personal development, and improving people's well-being.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working opportunity.

  • Opportunity to contribute to digital well-being products with a global audience.

  • Hands-on experience using advanced AI tools for content and video production.

  • Exposure to innovative content formats and AI-powered product experiences.

  • Opportunity to take ownership of creative projects and contribute new ideas.

  • Collaborative environment that encourages curiosity, initiative, and professional development.

  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on users' everyday well-being.

In this fully remote role, you will help strengthen organizational resilience by developing and maintaining business continuity and crisis management programs. You will play a key role in ensuring that critical business operations remain prepared to respond effectively to unexpected disruptions. Working closely with stakeholders across different business units and geographies, you will coordinate recovery exercises, assess operational risks, and monitor compliance with internal policies and external requirements. You will also contribute to audits, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives, helping translate findings into practical corrective actions. This is an opportunity to combine strategic planning with hands-on coordination in an international, collaborative environment where your work directly supports business continuity and operational resilience.

lists.content:
• Design, develop, and maintain business continuity and crisis management plans across business functions and geographical locations.

  • Coordinate business continuity and disaster recovery exercises, including scenario development, execution, documentation, and post-exercise reviews.

  • Collaborate with business leaders to identify critical processes, recovery priorities, business dependencies, and recovery objectives.

  • Ensure continuity plans remain accurate, up to date, regularly tested, and aligned with integrated risk management practices.

  • Monitor global readiness activities, track plan coverage and test results, and follow up on identified gaps and remediation actions.

  • Support continuous improvement by translating lessons learned from incidents, simulations, and recovery exercises into updated strategies and plans.

  • Work with Risk, Compliance, Corporate Security, IT, and operational teams to identify and document gaps related to corporate policies, security standards, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements.

  • Assist with audits, compliance reviews, risk assessments, and documentation requests by gathering supporting evidence and tracking findings through resolution.

  • Monitor continuity and resilience gaps, corrective actions, exceptions, and remediation activities, ensuring appropriate follow-up through closure.

    • Requirements:

  • Previous experience developing, implementing, and maintaining business continuity or crisis management plans.

  • Hands-on experience supporting or coordinating business continuity and disaster recovery testing, simulations, or exercises.

  • Ability to assess business processes, identify critical activities, and evaluate recovery priorities and operational dependencies.

  • Experience coordinating projects and activities across multiple stakeholders, teams, or geographical regions.

  • Good understanding of business continuity, disaster recovery, operational risk management, or related frameworks.

  • Strong documentation and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare clear continuity plans, assessment reports, findings, and action plans.

  • Basic understanding of corporate security, risk management, compliance, or regulatory requirements, with an interest in developing further expertise in these areas.

  • Ability to interpret policies, standards, and regulatory requirements and translate them into practical, measurable activities and documentation.

  • Advanced to fluent English proficiency, both written and spoken.

  • Strong communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting global or multi-regional business continuity and resilience programs.

  • Familiarity with integrated risk management processes and audit-oriented environments.

  • Experience facilitating tabletop exercises, crisis simulations, or other business continuity testing activities.

  • Professional certifications in business continuity, disaster recovery, or risk management.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement from Brazil.

  • Full-time employment opportunity.

  • Regular working schedule: Monday to Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

  • Access to professional development opportunities and continuous learning resources.

  • Opportunities to pursue industry-recognized certifications and develop expertise in business continuity, risk management, and related technologies.

  • Access to coaching, hands-on learning experiences, and career development support.

  • Well-being initiatives designed to support physical, mental, financial, and social health.

  • A collaborative and inclusive international working environment that encourages knowledge sharing, professional growth, and belonging.

lists.content:
Take ownership of the brand's overall narrative, ensuring that its communication remains consistent, authentic, and relevant across all audience touchpoints. You will combine community insights, strategic planning, creative development, and direct execution to build meaningful engagement and strengthen brand perception.

  • Monitor customer sentiment and public perception through community discussions, CS2 conversations, customer support feedback, Product insights, and business intelligence.

  • Identify what audiences appreciate, what concerns them, and how their perceptions evolve over time.

  • Collaborate with management and Product teams to translate business direction and product developments into a clear, compelling brand narrative.

  • Ensure consistency across social media, blogs, product communications, community interactions, and larger content initiatives while adapting messaging to different audiences.

  • Develop and manage content plans aligned with product roadmaps, events, releases, and developments within the CS2 and esports communities.

  • Create engaging content concepts, including gaming-related productions, community-focused initiatives, collaborations, short-form videos, and larger creative projects.

  • Maximize the value of content production by repurposing collaborations, shoots, and creative assets into multiple deliverables.

  • Direct designers, editors, copywriters, creators, and external production partners, providing clear briefs, feedback, and creative guidance.

  • Take responsibility for the quality and final delivery of creative projects while remaining actively involved in execution.

  • Maintain an authentic and continuous presence within the community, ensuring communication feels natural, relevant, and genuinely engaged rather than limited to promotional announcements.

  • Manage creative resources and production budgets thoughtfully, balancing quality, impact, and commercial efficiency.

    • Requirements:

    We are looking for a proactive, independent, and highly creative professional with strong storytelling abilities and the confidence to take ownership of both strategy and execution. The ideal candidate combines excellent communication skills, emotional intelligence, audience awareness, and commercial judgment with the ability to lead creative projects and collaborate effectively across different teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative, work independently, and deliver results without requiring constant direction or extensive team support.

  • Strong creative thinking and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop compelling narratives and translate ideas into engaging content.

  • Hands-on approach, with the ability to contribute directly to content creation and execution rather than relying entirely on others.

  • High emotional intelligence and a strong understanding of psychology, audience behavior, and brand perception.

  • Curiosity and research skills, with a genuine interest in understanding what communities are discussing, appreciating, and criticizing.

  • Strong organizational and project management abilities, including content planning, prioritization, and execution.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with management, Product, Customer Relations, BI, and creative professionals.

  • Experience directing creative work, briefing collaborators, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining high-quality output.

  • Commercial awareness and the ability to manage production, collaboration, and external contractor costs efficiently.

  • Familiarity with CS2, esports, gaming, and internet culture is highly desirable, along with the ability to become deeply immersed in these communities quickly.

    • Benefits:

  • Opportunity to take ownership of the brand's creative direction, storytelling, and community presence.

  • A hands-on, high-impact role combining strategic responsibility with creative execution.

  • Direct collaboration with management, Product teams, and creative professionals.

  • Opportunity to develop original content concepts, creative campaigns, and community-driven initiatives.

  • Flexibility to work with internal creative resources and external contractors to bring ideas to life.

  • Remote working opportunity.
